name: NBCFDC Education Loan (Demo Placeholder)
description: Placeholder rule data modelled on the NBCFDC education loan scheme for OBC/EBC/DNT applicants. DEMO DATA ONLY.

source.note: Placeholder pending the official NBCFDC document. Not an official source.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to OBC, EBC or DNT category.
Annual family income must not exceed the rural/urban limit (rural INR 1,00,000, urban INR 1,20,000).
Applicant age must be between 18 and 35 years.
Course must be an undergraduate, postgraduate, professional, diploma or certificate course.

financials.source_note: Demo financial parameters pending the official rate table.

claims: Annual family income limit is INR 1,00,000 for rural applicants and INR 1,20,000 for urban applicants.
The education loan interest rate is 10.5% per annum.
